fields.name: asin
fields.description: ASIN code, max length 1000 characters. This tool can only query one ASIN at a time

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country site, default US. Options (13 total): US, UK, DE, CA, JP, FR, ES, IT, MX, AU, AE, BR, SA

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Keyword, max length 1000. Translate to the corresponding country's language whenever possible

fields.name: timePieceType
fields.description: Time slice type, default latelyDay. Options: latelyDay (last N days), month (a specific month), week (a specific week)

fields.name: timePieceValue
fields.description: Time slice value, default 7, max length 1000. For latelyDay only 7 or 30; for month format YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-04); for week format week start date YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-04-13)

fields.name: conditions
fields.description:
Condition filters, comma-separated. Options:
Flag type: nfPosition (natural traffic keyword), isSpAd (SP ad keyword), isBrandAd (brand ad keyword), isVedioAd (video ad keyword), isAC (AC recommended keyword), isAccurateKw (precise traffic keyword), isAccurateTailKw (precise long-tail keyword), isPurchaseKw (converting keyword), isQualityKw (high-quality conversion keyword), isStableKw (stable conversion keyword), isLossKw (lost conversion keyword), isInvalidKw (invalid impression keyword), isMultiVariantKw (multi-variant natural rank keyword), isSearchVolUpKw (search volume YoY growth keyword), isSearchVolDownKw (search volume YoY decline keyword)
Period count type (.total all / .in new): totalPeriod.in, nfKeywordCnt.total, nfKeywordCnt.in, adKeywordCnt.total, adKeywordCnt.in, allSpKeywordCnt.total, allSpKeywordCnt.in, spKeywordCnt.total, spKeywordCnt.in, recSpKeywordCnt.total, recSpKeywordCnt.in, allSbKeywordCnt.total, allSbKeywordCnt.in, sbKeywordCnt.total, sbKeywordCnt.in, sbvKeywordCnt.total, sbvKeywordCnt.in

fields.name: sortBy
fields.description: Sort field. Options: lastRank (natural rank), adLastRank (ad rank), updateTime (keyword crawl time), searchesRank (search rank), estSearchesNum (monthly search volume). Empty string means default system sort

fields.name: desc
fields.description: Whether to sort descending, default true

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Results per page, min 10, max 100, default 100
